evidence.chaos: He plays George mostly straight but allows NPCs to create lighter chaos; mostly controlled world-building.
evidence.heroism: George offers to help the party escape and scouts the garrison; basic support but not particularly selfless given his undercover position.
evidence.comedy: Sustained comedic scenes like the Fredo/Samo friendship moment, the Samoan marriage dilemma, and playful banter about birthdays and elves throughout.
evidence.immersion: Detailed NPC voices, environmental descriptions like 'Toyota dealership spotlight beams,' and sustained roleplay across multiple scenes with George, Fredo, Cassandra.
evidence.strategy: Provides tactical advice on timing explosions, suggests the Sexy Peacock as a safe hideout, warns about city lockdown—clearly thinking ahead about the heist logistics.
evidence.curiosity: Asks probing questions about the plan and pushes players to consider logistics; 'Do y'all have a way out?' and builds world details organically.

evidence.chaos: Generally cautious about the plan; joked about Colonel Sanders flash mob but mostly stays on task.
evidence.heroism: Tells Leliana 'if you see an opportunity to kill his ass, I got your back'—willing to risk the mission for her revenge against Captain Steel.
evidence.comedy: Good comedic timing with lines like 'You don't believe that' and riffs on business jargon; not the primary joke engine but solid contributions.
evidence.immersion: Sustained in-character decision-making; speaks as Silas throughout, maintains the halfling worker cover, thinks through character motivations.
evidence.strategy: Drives the entire heist planning; 'should we split up? have two people go to the factory, two to the garrison'; coordinates timing, anticipates complications with the research center, deliberates escape routes methodically.
evidence.curiosity: Asks about the scientist's presence, confirms George's role, questions detonation methods ('Detonators exist'), but mostly focused on execution rather than exploration.

evidence.chaos: Mostly follows the plan; mild impulsiveness with 'I'm gonna be Stephanie from Full House' and some playful tangents but nothing derailing.
evidence.heroism: Participates in the group's efforts but no standout self-sacrifice; willing to go along with the heist but not driving it.
evidence.comedy: Solid joke contributions: 'CM Junk,' 'Brainies,' various quips about the party and NPCs; present but not dominating the humor.
evidence.immersion: Strong roleplay at the party scene; good interaction with Cassandra and Gracie, maintains cover, reacts authentically to events like the lake swim.
evidence.strategy: Follows Silas's lead on the heist plan; offers minor input on timing and tactics but defers to group decisions.
evidence.curiosity: Asks about harmonic engines, inquires about other cities, gathers intel from Cassandra's friends about factory layoffs—moderate engagement with world-building.

evidence.chaos: Minimal chaos; focused on the mission. One mistake with the bomb timer but corrects course quickly.
evidence.heroism: Expresses strong determination to confront Captain Steel: 'I'm gonna do something. I don't know what. I'm gonna do something'; takes on most dangerous solo mission at the barracks; risked visibility to disable the bomb.
evidence.comedy: Occasional light moments ('the sexy peacock,' comments on brain talkies) but mostly serious and mission-focused.
evidence.immersion: Good in-character roleplay as Leliana/Helisana; maintains cover at the barracks, reacts authentically to bomb timer malfunction, engages in downtime conversations.
evidence.strategy: Suggests using the Sexy Peacock as a hideout, proposes trying the World Tree as escape route, helps brainstorm logistics—solid strategic input without dominating.
evidence.curiosity: Asks clarifying questions about the plan, shows interest in escape routes, inquires about whether she can see people; moderate engagement.

mvp.quote: I'm going to send out a message to all my teammates. I can probably go and scoop the ticket up really quick, but if you guys can make a distraction for me for just a few seconds, I can probably do it.

most_chaotic.quote: So that's why he's not here. Yep. It's canon now. [re: Bru being carried off by Colonel Sanders flash mob]
